text.en:
The benefits of Act Numbered Eighteen hundred and fifty-seven are hereby extended to male
and female teachers of municipalities and of townships inhabited by Christian tribes in to, Palawan, Mindoro
and Palawan, and in the subprovince of Abra, subject to the same conditions as those established by the Act
referred to.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 20, 1909.
